BetaFormula.description: Formula linking levered and unlevered beta.

oneOf.description:
Hamada: β_L = β_U + (β_U − β_D)(1 − t) D/E (debt at a fixed amount, tax shield at the
cost of debt).
Harris-Pringle: β_L = β_U + (β_U − β_D) D/E (debt rebalanced to a target ratio).

debt_beta.description: Beta of debt, dimensionless. Default: 0 (risk-free debt).

debt_to_equity.description: Target debt-to-equity ratio D/E, decimal, not negative.

tax_rate.description: Tax rate of the tax shield, decimal fraction from 0 to below 1.

country_exposure.description:
Exposure of the company to the country risk (lambda), dimensionless, not negative.
Default: 1.

country_risk_premium.description: Country risk premium, annual decimal fraction, not negative. Default: 0.

equity_risk_premium.description: Equity risk premium of the market, annual decimal fraction.

levered_beta.description: Levered beta, dimensionless. Give exactly one of `levered_beta` and `relever`.

relever.description:
Unlevered beta and target structure to relever. Give exactly one of `levered_beta` and
`relever`.

size_premium.description: Size premium, annual decimal fraction. Default: 0.

specific_risk_justification.description: Written reason for the specific risk premium, echoed in the audit trail.

specific_risk_premium.description:
Company-specific risk premium, annual decimal fraction. Default: 0. When not zero,
`specific_risk_justification` is required.
